description: Asks what type, size and value an expression gets when its operand is the Memo column M instead of the Text column T, for the rows with ID 2 (embedded U+0000) and 5 (odd-byte BSTR): M, M & '', M & M, Left, Mid, Trim, UCase, Len, LenB, M = T, M Like, InStr, Replace, StrReverse, CStr, Format, IIf, Nz and Asc of M, and Space(Len(M)). Each form is one snapshot per row with the Field Name, Type, Size, Attributes and Value. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
